svg.title: OpenStreetMap walking directions to event location
svg.desc: OpenStreetMap base map with KML walking path, parking, gate, Gardner-Bailey House, and Edgewood Club markers overlaid. Path length is about 0.27 miles.

g.text: Park at Parking, enter at Gate, then follow the green route north.

text.font-family: Avenir Next, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
